result.summary: PASS. Engine.append_pending_event_arms_multi/7 is a thin @doc false wrapper reusing existing private prepare_timer_arms / prepare_service_task_dispatch_abort_on_empty_url / build_*_multi helpers; resolution is eager (before any Multi.run), errors return {:error,_} and are mapped by SubProcess to the existing activation_failed to_error_args shape. Timer/dispatch steps are appended after the token reconciliation step (real TokenRecord ids exist; identity id_map mirrors complete_task/3). Duplicate Multi step names guarded by Enum.uniq on transition ++ hop pending events; step names are keyed by token_id. Tenant id derived from schema prefix, not input. Pure transactional context code: no process, supervisor or GenServer added, consistent with the Engine process-vs-row decision (REQ-045); InstanceSupervisor untouched. No new behaviours/macros; only new public surface is one @doc false function. Fixtures/seeds/alias/drift-test/ISS-0931 doc edits match the design; 8D child is START->HUMAN_TASK(role-procurement-manager)->END; parent v1.2 definition_name set; simulation YAML parity; child seeded before parent. No QA data changed; no unrelated files (orchestrator.log/registry.json are ORCH bookkeeping; untracked docs/issues/ISS-0929.yaml is the run's issue). No anti-patterns.md entry applies. SECURITY skip judged justified: no route, authz, tenant derivation, migration, secrets or response shaping touched; tenant_id comes from schema prefix via TenantProvisioning as in complete_task/3. Independent verification: mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force clean; mix test for engine_sub_process_test, engine/sub_process_test, persona_actor_seed_drift_test, qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test exit 0.
